statusBar.viewAIDetails: Click to view AI output details

featureTour.label: Meet your writing partner
featureTour.reopen: You can replay this tour from “Feature tour” in the top bar.
featureTour.copied: Copied. Paste into the assistant and send when ready.
featureTour.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the example and copy it manually.

agent.title: Give your story a new direction
agent.description: Describe your creative intent. The assistant reads the current project and adjusts related settings, characters and future chapter plans. It asks you about important uncertainties.
agent.example: Bring the antagonist’s exit forward, then adjust the following plot and relationships. Keep the existing prose for now, and ask me about anything uncertain.
agent.hint: Open the AI assistant on the right. A project and generation model are needed. To revise existing prose, specify the chapter and the change.

history.title: See what changed, and undo it
history.description: The assistant records its content revisions. Review the impact and before-and-after text, then undo a revision if the affected content has not changed again.
history.hint: Use “Story revision history” in the assistant header. For prose, try “Rewrite the latest unfinalized draft of chapter 2 in third person.” Finalized, archived and older drafts are protected.

blueprints.title: Know what each chapter needs to do
blueprints.description: Blueprints collect the chapter purpose, key events, cast and suspense. Edit them yourself or generate them with AI, then ask the assistant to connect the next part of the story.
blueprints.hint: Open a project → Chapter blueprints in the left sidebar. Save your edits. Blueprints are plans; chapter prose is in Drafts.

rehearsal.title: Rehearse three possible directions
rehearsal.description: Select a chapter and describe your intent and constraints. Compare three plot directions, then try a short scene from your favourite before committing to it.
rehearsal.hint: Chapter blueprints → select a chapter → Story rehearsal. Append your choice to author guidance and save. Copy scene excerpts separately before leaving the page.

models.title: Two steps to start writing together
models.description: Add your own generation model, then create or open a novel project. If you use local Ollama, start its service first.
models.hint: Open Settings in the top bar. Generation models write prose. Full-text knowledge search works without an embedding model; vector search requires one.
